paper.title: Shattering the Symmetry Trap in Fixed-Ansatz VQE: An Accelerated ADAPT-VQE Study of Three Pillar Molecules under Bravyi-Kitaev Mapping
paper.found_by: Valency semantic_search_papers (query: lithium hydride LiH molecular qubit Hamiltonian VQE bond dissociation), 2026-10-22

basis.reason: ASSUMPTION: the paper does not state its basis set. STO-3G is inferred: frozen-core LiH with 5 active spatial orbitals implies 6 basis functions, the STO-3G count for LiH. Every component of the paper's energy decomposition (total, frozen-core shift, active-space energy, nuclear repulsion) matches the RHF decomposition at STO-3G to within 7e-7 Ha (see energy_decomposition_check.json). This strongly supports, but does not prove, the inference.

reference_state.source: Appendix A.1 run log (base64-encoded in the HTML)
reference_state.note: Under Bravyi-Kitaev a qubit stores a parity, so counting 1s does not count electrons. Decoded explicitly (decode_reference.py) under the Fenwick-tree BK convention with qubit 0 first, which reproduces Chemistry Studio's HF bitstring 1000000000, |1111000000> is the 4-electron occupation 1011000100; with qubit 0 last it is 2 same-spin electrons; read as a Jordan-Wigner occupation it is 4 electrons. None is the 2-electron Hartree-Fock state. The exact implementation error in the paper is not established.
